name: Wireless Protocol Reverse Engineering
description: Ability to reverse-engineer unknown or proprietary wireless protocols from signal captures. Covers identification of framing and synchronization patterns, bit-level protocol structure extraction, state machine inference, correlation of RF activity with device behavior, and reconstruction of protocol specifications sufficient for security analysis.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to wireless protocol reverse engineering

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the concept and methodology of wireless protocol reverse engineering
evidence: Can describe the general approach to reverse-engineering an unknown wireless protocol
Understands common framing patterns (preamble, sync word, length, CRC) in digital protocols
Completed training on protocol reverse engineering fundamentals

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Assists in protocol reverse engineering tasks under supervision
evidence: Identified preamble and sync word patterns in demodulated bitstreams under guidance
Correlated RF transmission patterns with observed device behavior under supervision
Used Inspectrum, Universal Radio Hacker, or equivalent to analyze signal structure with assistance

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently reverse-engineers standard-complexity proprietary wireless protocols
evidence: Independently reverse-engineered the framing and field structure of 3+ unknown wireless protocols
Identified and documented CRC/checksum algorithms, field encodings, and state transitions
Correlated protocol fields with device functions through systematic behavioral testing
Produced protocol specification documents sufficient for independent security analysis

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Reverse-engineers complex protocols with encryption or frequency agility; develops RE tools
evidence: Reverse-engineered protocols using encryption, obfuscation, or frequency hopping
Inferred protocol state machines from traffic analysis and device behavior correlation
Developed custom protocol analysis and visualization tools for the lab
Mentors junior analysts on reverse engineering methodology and technique selection

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on wireless protocol reverse engineering; publishes novel techniques
evidence: Published research on wireless protocol reverse engineering methods or findings
Reverse-engineered protocols that led to significant security vulnerability discoveries
Authored the lab's wireless protocol reverse engineering methodology
Trains teams on reverse engineering techniques and develops lab RE capabilities

assessment_methods.description: Given signal captures from an unknown wireless device, identify the modulation, extract the framing structure, and document the protocol fields and their likely purpose
Reverse-engineer a proprietary wireless protocol from a provided IoT device, producing a protocol specification and security analysis
